Captured non-JSON ArtifactResult-style manifest rejected; output inventory must be exact complete OutputSet plus declared files
Actual request/IR/profile/lock/tool bytes and semantic source/task/profile/generation lineage crosschecked; selfconsistent wrong producer/source/policy/selector still rejected
Actual structure/policy/shape digests recomputed; presence or matching claims not enough
Bundled schema bytes fixed, component package source identity not confused with installed image bytes
Future slots bind exact returned byte sets; unknown/missing/multiply assigned slots or observations rejected
Input/request/manifest/generated path conflicts checked, including existing FrozenInputs structural ancestor rejection
Per-step original OutputSet retained separately; no synthetic combined OutputSet, no composition/profile/source-lock writeback
Immutable accepted bytes survive subsequent mutation of caller memory
Private output fields and readonly accessors; no ArtifactRecipe implementation, accepted flag, host process receipt, Source/Candidate commit or publication authority
Shared execution changes only crate visibility; legacy profile/1 admission and its profile/2 refusal remain separate
limitations: Required step recipes are trusted host facts; binder is not a policy for choosing arbitrary recipes
Does not prove a real process produced bytes, installed image execution, EOF/exit/cleanup/cancellation, filesystem confinement, environment or permissions

Slot sources reject absent public IDs but do not prove every claimed implementation or public export exists
Current synthetic bytes do not certify C07 profile/2 generation; real C07 v1 probes retain original identities
Opaque SDK/dependency closure, full combination transaction, downstream physical assembly and independent target consumer acceptance remain separate
